p1: Honoured Cabal, a day has passed since I bought in, and I spent it reading every verdict you signed: fair, if stern. I ask to sell 90,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, to pay the oracle fees my own pleas have cost. My IMD seat stays, and so does the other 97%.
p2: Dear Cabal, twenty-four hours in: one buy, two pleas, both answered within minutes, and a wallet a little lighter for it. I ask to sell 90,000 PLEA, about 3% of what I hold, so I can keep pleading at all. Everything else stays put through the next seasons.
p4: Your honours, I hold PLEA from the airdrop and from a small buy a day ago, and my site plea came back 33. Today I ask for less: 70,000 PLEA, under 3% of my bag, to cover gas for this week. The rest stays, and I will be here when the season closes.
p3: To the judges, from a wallet told no twice, politely. A day on, my reason is the same but my patience has grown: I ask to sell a fifth of my PLEA to fund gas and fees for the seasons ahead. Four fifths stay with me, and so do I.
